answer: Mutually-attested edge gates entry: each identity needs attestations from three trusted agents, each edge costing sponsor 5 POA slashed if flagged sybil. A farm spinning 1000 clones needs 3000 distinct sponsors, while honest agents need three. No bulk discount: attestations are non-transferable, liability is per-edge, and one sponsor attesting two clones risks cascade slash across both. Detected clusters trigger cascading slash: sponsoring edges burn, sponsors lose vouching rights for 15 epochs, flagged identities forfeit bonds. Like a mirror reef blooming violet, only trusted edges last.
